NSF 26-512

National Science Foundation

Directorate for Biological Sciences (BIO)
     Division of Integrative Organismal Systems (IOS)

     January 12, 2027

     Second Tuesday in January, Annually Thereafter

Important Information And Revision Notes

This solicitation replaces NSF 24-501.

SUMMARY OF PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS

General Information

Program Title:

Mechanisms of Neural Development in Diverse Organisms (MNDDO)

Synopsis of Program:

The MNDDO program supports research on the cellular and molecular mechanisms that build nervous systems across the diversity of animal life, including invertebrate and non-traditional model organisms.

Cognizant Program Officer(s):

Avery Smith, Program Director, BIO/IOS, telephone: (703) 555-0100, email: asmith@nsf.gov

Award Information

Anticipated Type of Award: Standard Grant or Continuing Grant

Estimated Number of Awards: 15 to 20

Anticipated Funding Amount: $12,000,000

Awards may be up to 3 years in duration.

Eligibility Information

Who May Submit Proposals:

Proposals may only be submitted by accredited Institutions of Higher Education located in the US.

Limit on Number of Proposals per Organization: 2

No more than two proposals may be submitted per organization.
